evidence_snippets: List of Schema.org Proposals The following list identifies schema.org terms based on vocabulary proposals from Gmail: Action - proposal: Actions in Schema.org Order - proposal: Orders in Schema.org Reservation - proposal: Reservations in Schema.org EmailMessage - proposal: EmailMessage Type Schema.org vocabularies are developed through public discussions in the W3C Schema.org Community Group .
Google has worked with the schema.org community to standardize its mail-related schemas so that other email services and email clients can also take full advantage of them.
When this process is complete, Google will try to make any necessary transition as smooth as possible for all developers using these schemas as well as for their users.
